observations.why: The utterance performs a binding requirement imposed on deployments, enacting authority through a mandatory gate rather than reciprocity or proportional exchange.
The heading organizes what follows as settled decisions, positioning the speaker as presenting an authoritative determination.
The rule is presented as a requirement, directly enacting permission and compliance through a gate.
The statement extends the authoritative rule across deployment environments, specifying its jurisdiction.
Assigning an owner establishes rank-based responsibility and authority for the decision.
